question: Should ClawHub accept this notification slice as capped in-mutation fanout after the gating fix and runtime proof, or pause it until the follow/feed stack has a durable queued notification design?
rationale: The correctness bug is mechanical, but the permanent notification API, stored user state, fanout cap, and stack order require maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Fix and prove this slice
options.body: Gate notifications on the newly inserted release scan status, keep the bounded fanout design, and require real Convex proof before final review.

options.title: Pause for durable fanout
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers choose a queued or replayable notification architecture for larger publisher audiences.

options.title: Restack after dependencies
options.body: Land or close the follow graph and follow controls PRs first, then rebase this PR as a smaller notification-only review.

recommendation.title: Fix and prove this slice
recommendation.body: Gate notifications on the newly inserted release scan status, keep the bounded fanout design, and require real Convex proof before final review.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the strongest current-history owner for the publish path and schema baseline where the safety gate and stored notification model attach.
